title: Outline Panel: one region of the editor, drawn by a sandboxed Panel
summary: The Project outline: the storyboard's scenes and shots with their status, length, narration and on-screen text. Each scene or shot drags into the next message as context. What a Outline Panel promises the editor: it draws in a sandboxed frame, answers init within 3 seconds, and reaches the Project only through the bridge calls it declares (project.view, workspace.context).

carrier.notes: Shipped as lumeri.outline-panel 0.1.0; placed in the workspace module outline. The page is assembled by the Host (iface:luc.panel-adapter/v1) and talks only through iface:editor.panel-bridge/v1.

replaceability.why: panel/v2 is an open protocol. A replacement is a page with no network in a sandboxed frame; it reaches the Project only through bridge calls it declares, each authorized by the Host, never more than this interface's bridge_calls. A layered Panel that breaks falls back to the Official Panel as shipped.
replaceability.decided: self-Luc inventory 1a, Reserved no (panel/v2 is open): docs/luc/self-luc-inventory.md:68

reach.notes: bridge_calls is the ceiling: a replacement for this role may declare fewer calls, never others.

operations.name: mount
operations.notes: The editor mounts the Panel's page in its module and posts init; the Panel answers alive (or the shim answers fault) within 3000 ms and from then on draws, calls and listens through the bridge. The errors are the editor's names for a mount that failed.

bounds.name: width_percent
bounds.unit: percent of the workspace width it opens at

bounds.name: height_percent
bounds.unit: percent of the workspace height it opens at

bounds.name: title_chars
bounds.unit: characters per title locale; English required; only the 10 editor languages

invariants.text: The Official framework contains the Outline as its second module, shown by default, with calls project.view and workspace.context.
On init it answers alive once and asks for the shotlist view.
A layered Outline that breaks gives way to the Outline as shipped; the break is counted once.
A Panel that does not answer init within 3000 ms is removed and reported as E_LUC_PANEL_SILENT.

The outline module of the Official workspace is this interface's role: another Luc's Panel fills it only while it keeps this interface, within its reach, and otherwise this Panel takes the module back.

break: no alive within 3000 ms of the page or of init (E_LUC_PANEL_SILENT)
an uncaught script error or rejection before init (E_LUC_PANEL_SCRIPT)
the frame navigates away from its page (E_LUC_PANEL_NAVIGATED)
the served page does not match the catalog's hash (E_LUC_PANEL_CHANGED)
failure.notes: A layered version that breaks gives way to the Official Panel as shipped, in the same place (luc.module_fell_back). When the Official Panel itself fails, the editor's built-in view of this module takes over (iface:editor.builtin-panels/v1). Breaks after the page is up (a later exception, a hung call) are not detected.

known_deviations.text: It subscribes to theme.changed, which the editor never sends; it gets the theme only at init.
